body: We’re releasing an analysis showing that since 2012 the amount of compute needed to train a neural net to the same performance on ImageNet classification has been decreasing by a factor of 2 every 16 months. Compared to 2012, it now takes 44 times less compute to train a neural network to the level of AlexNet (by contrast, Moore’s Law would yield an 11x cost improvement over this period). Our results suggest that for AI tasks with high levels of recent investment, algorithmic progress has yielded more gains than classical hardware efficiency.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布分析报告指出，自2012年以来，在ImageNet分类任务上将神经网络训练至相同性能所需的计算量每16个月减少一半。相比2012年，训练至AlexNet水平所需的计算量减少了44倍（同期摩尔定律仅带来11倍提升）。研究结果表明，对于获得大量投资的AI任务，算法进展带来的效率提升比经典硬件效率更为显著。

计算量，指训练或运行深度学习模型所需的硬件算力资源
